steps.content: Someone shrieks: The elevator's here!
Many people spring up from their seats and surge towards the elevators.
They all try to squeeze into the two elevators, elbowing each other out of the way.
Some guests, however, remain seated and keep drinking the soup, as if the pandemonium before their eyes has nothing to do with them.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: Should we go, Chief? You heard the head chef... first-come-first-served... legendary ingredients...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's too crowded. Let's wait a bit before we go... We won't be able to try the legendary ingredients if we get trampled in the stampede.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: But...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't worry. We have our spot-saver right here.
You point at Cabernet, who smiles gently at you two. Kelvin calms down and follows you to the tail end of the crowd.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This way, we can also pick up Macchiato along the way.
You come to the side of the elevator, but there's no one there.
There's only a pile of brown, half-melted ice cream on the ground giving off the scent of caramel.
At that moment, the elevator door opens again. The remaining guests rush in, leaving only enough space for three more.
Seeing as they hadn't get to go downstairs sooner, it was a bit of a consolation to share an elevator with Cabernet.
Cabernet smiles and walks in confidently. You and Kelvin follow closely behind.
As soon as you enter the elevator, the crowd separates you from Cabernet.
Like a bus at rush hour, you're totally enveloped by the crowd in this overloaded elevator.
Though it's just one floor down, the ride is quite nauseating. Inside the tiny space, the other guests breathe down your neck, and their sweaty skin sticks against yours.
You're squeezed face-first against the wall, and can faintly hear Cabernet and Kelvin behind you.
A girl in a similarly suffocating position as you is pleading quietly.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Girl
steps.content: Stop... stop pushing... let me out...

steps.speaker: Mysterious Girl
steps.content: It's dangerous here... quick... get out of here...
On the pool deck above, the scorching sun is still shining, and the empty swimming pool is eerily silent.
Melting ice cream, coffee, and milky white soup are spilled everywhere.
They emit piteous wails as they evaporate.
